description: A Flutter widget representing the reader screen in an e-book application. It manages displaying chapter content, font and theme controls, bookmark actions, and handles loading state and errors.

classes.name: ReaderScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays the content of a book chapter, along with controls for navigation and customization.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget, _ReaderScreenState.

methods.name: _chapterLabel
methods.description: Generates a string label describing the current chapter position and title.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Overrides the method to perform actions when dependency data changes, particularly to load a book based on route arguments.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for rendering the reader interface, including loading indicator, error message, chapter content, and controls.
